name: zc_avatar_hism

tests.name: there is a Project Avatar figure to spawn
every pass was measured with the clock running

detail.note: all zeroes means the stat unit overlay stopped drawing, not that an avatar became free

tests.name: the two passes at each setting agree well enough to compare the settings

detail.note: the same setting measured early and late. If these disagree by more than the gap between SETTINGS, the experiment measured the machine and not the quadtree.

tests.name: the quadtree is or is not costing a Project Avatar time

detail.note: reported either way, and only meaningful if H02 passed. A positive gap larger than the disagreement says the plain component is cheaper for this shape of data and the default should change; anything smaller says the tree is not where the 15.5 ms lives.
